say:2:1820627001:0.female: There you are! What made Jay and the others come back?

say:4:1820627002:0.text: What... You told them Bantus was hunting me down?!
say:4:1820627002:0.source_cn: 什么……你们将班题斯追捕老身的事告诉他们了？！
say:4:1820627002:0.male: What... You told them Bantus was hunting me down?!
say:4:1820627002:0.female: What... You told them Bantus was hunting me down?!

say:5:1820627003:0.text: We didn't. Jay just put two and two together because you mentioned Bantus.
say:5:1820627003:0.source_cn: 不。是你嘱咐他们离开时提到了班题斯，被杰农猜到了。

say:6:1820627004:0.text: Some of them may behave like animals now, but they haven't lost their ability to think. You can't keep the truth from them forever.
say:6:1820627004:0.source_cn: 虽然他们之中已经有一些亡灵的行为模式很贴近动物，但终归...

say:7:1820627005:0.text: *Sigh*... I should've taken that into account.

say:8:1820627006:0.text: It was just an offhand remark, and I never thought they'd take it to heart...
say:8:1820627006:0.source_cn: 原只是担心他们，多问了一句。没想到竟被他们放在了心上……

say:9:1820627007:0.text: ... Why did you transfer their souls into animals? The corpses Bantus sends to Novaris should be more than enough.
say:9:1820627007:0.source_cn: ……为什么要将亡灵的灵魂转移到动物身上？班题斯应该往诺...

say:10:1820627008:0.text: Yes, that's true. But that's only been the case for the past thirty years!
say:10:1820627008:0.source_cn: 是，是运送来不少。但那都是最近三十年的事！

say:11:1820627009:1.text: Before Lady Tephesia pledged her allegiance to Bantus, Novaris had no stable source of bodies. We had to make do with dead animals.
say:11:1820627009:1.source_cn: 在领主阁下臣服之前，诺珐斯没有稳定的肢体来源。能找来些...

say:12:1820627010:1.text: That's the reality Jay and the others have always known. Even the youngest among them has lived in Novaris for nearly a thousand years...
say:12:1820627010:1.source_cn: 而杰农他们，最年轻的也已在诺珐斯生活了近千年……

choice_prompt:13:1820627010.text: That's the reality Jay and the others have always known. Even the youngest among them has lived in Novaris for nearly a thousand years...
choice_prompt:13:1820627010.source_cn: 而杰农他们，最年轻的也已在诺珐斯生活了近千年……

say:14:1820627011:0.text: It takes an immensely powerful mage to bind a soul to a lifeless object. Otherwise, the soul will suffer eternal pain.
say:14:1820627011:0.source_cn: 若想将灵魂囿于从未拥有过生命力的死物，施法者必须拥有极...

say:15:1820627012:0.text: I didn't have that kind of mana, so I had no choice but to use dead animals.
say:15:1820627012:0.source_cn: 老身无能，没有那么强的魔力，只能以动物尸体为替代。

say:16:1820627013:1.text: Baba Muriel's words remind you of Callan, whose soul is trapped inside a machine, leaving him in constant agony.
say:16:1820627013:1.source_cn: 穆婆婆的话让你不由得想起了铐兰——他的灵魂就被囿于机械...
say:16:1820627013:1.male: Baba Muriel's words remind you of Callan, whose soul is trapped inside a machine, leaving him in constant agony.
say:16:1820627013:1.female: Baba Muriel's words remind you of Callan, whose soul is trapped inside a machine, leaving him in constant agony.

say:17:1820627014:0.text: Suddenly, it all makes sense. Baba Muriel is no Zorya, and she couldn't bear condemning the villagers to eternal suffering.
say:17:1820627014:0.source_cn: 很显然，穆婆婆无法与佐尔娅的魔法水平相较，但她更不想让...
say:17:1820627014:0.male: Suddenly, it all makes sense. Baba Muriel is no Zorya, and she couldn't bear condemning the villagers to eternal suffering.
say:17:1820627014:0.female: Suddenly, it all makes sense. Baba Muriel is no Zorya, and she couldn't bear condemning the villagers to eternal suffering.

say:19:1820627016:0.text: Don't look at me like that, mortal boy. Believe me, it's hard for me to see them living as animals, but this is the best we can do.
say:19:1820627016:0.source_cn: 收起你那复杂的眼神吧，生者小子。老身比你更不愿看到他们...

say:20:1820627017:1.text: As a matter of fact, animal bodies are remarkably long-lasting. Jay and the others only need new bodies every three to five centuries.
say:20:1820627017:1.source_cn: 若以事实而言，有灵魂寄居的动物身躯腐败得非常之慢。杰农...

choice_prompt:21:1820627017.text: As a matter of fact, animal bodies are remarkably long-lasting. Jay and the others only need new bodies every three to five centuries.
choice_prompt:21:1820627017.source_cn: 若以事实而言，有灵魂寄居的动物身躯腐败得非常之慢。杰农他们每三五百年才需换一次躯体。

say:22:1820627018:0.text: I haven't the slightest clue why. My only guess is that an animal's body can only hold a fragment of a human's consciousness. The mind grows quieter, no longer burdened by trivial matters.
say:22:1820627018:0.source_cn: 确切的缘由，老身也不清楚。只能推测是因为动物躯体所能承...

say:23:1820627019:0.text: As you can see, most of these animals have long since let go of their worldly worries. Jay, however, is an exception.
say:23:1820627019:0.source_cn: 你们方才应当见过了，许多灵魂早已抛却一切忧愁。像杰农这...
say:23:1820627019:0.male: As you can see, most of these animals have long since let go of their worldly worries. Jay, however, is an exception.
say:23:1820627019:0.female: As you can see, most of these animals have long since let go of their worldly worries. Jay, however, is an exception.

say:24:1820627020:0.text: ... You mean most of them are like Pipp?
say:24:1820627020:0.source_cn: ……更多的是像皮普那样的，是吗？

say:26:1820627022:1.text: Poor Pipp... He suffered a tragic death, and the body he was left with was in a terrible state. I'm just glad he no longer has to worry about it day after day.
say:26:1820627022:1.source_cn: 皮普那孩子也是可怜……生前死得凄惨，死后的躯体也因此格...

say:28:1820627024:0.text: Pipp said you're a good person. I suppose that's true for the people of Twilight Village... and for Baden.
say:28:1820627024:0.source_cn: 皮普说你是个好人。至少对于夕染村的村民……对于巴登，你...

say:29:1820627025:0.text: Hmph, spare me your compliments, mortal boy. My character is not yours to judge.
say:29:1820627025:0.source_cn: 哼，老身为人如何，自有亡灵评判。生者的夸奖还是免了吧，...

say:30:1820627026:0.text: Come along, all of you. I'll find a way to keep you safe.
say:30:1820627026:0.source_cn: 好了，杰农，你们跟老身走。老身得想个安全的法子保护你们。

say:31:1820627027:0.text: *Sigh* When will I ever have a moment of peace...
say:31:1820627027:0.source_cn: 唉，这一个一个的，真是不让老身省心……

choice:13:0:1.text: Why didn't you put their souls into dolls instead?
